outcome: prevalence of anemia (before delivery, immediate postpartum, 6 weeks postpartum)
compliance with healthcare recommendations (routine 6-week postpartum CBC test)
cohort: The study included 1558 women who delivered vaginally at Emek Medical Center.
finding: The study found similar rates of anemia before delivery and 6 weeks postpartum between Jewish and Arab women, with overall compliance with postpartum health recommendations being low regardless of ethnicity, contributing to persistent anemia.
